=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1645-1650 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Inadequate sanitization of test output allows potential workflow command injection.
  WHY: The `sed` commands `sed 's/^/    | /'` only prefix the start of each line from the test log. They do not escape or neutralize any workflow command sequences (e.g., `::error::`, `::set-output::`) that might exist mid-line or on subsequent lines of multi-line test output. A malicious or accidentally formatted test failure could inject workflow commands that the runner would interpret.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1642 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex `[A-Za-z0-9_]+` is too restrictive for identifying failing test names.
  WHY: Parameterized tests (e.g., `test_func[a:b]`) often use characters beyond `[A-Za-z0-9_]`. If a test failure does not match the strict regex, it will not be included in the `::error::` annotation, potentially causing confusion or masking which specific tests failed, even if the failure is printed in the log tail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
